text: dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的提示词优化插件：它在对话输入框右侧加入 ✨ 操作，将草稿和最近用户消息交给 Host 端优化服务，并把优化结果用于替换草稿。优化过程按目标、范围、要求和交付物整理任务描述，复用当前会话选择的模型；草稿在请求期间发生变化时会提供手动采用选项。适合希望把简短或粗略需求整理成清晰任务提示的 DSH 用户。

dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer adds a rewrite button to the DSH Web composer. It sends the draft and recent user turns to a Host service and returns a clearer task brief using the session model. If the draft changes during the request, the result can be applied manually.
想把输入框里随手写的需求整理成清晰的任务提示。
DSH 有没有一键润色当前草稿的办法？
让提示词改写时参考最近几轮对话内容。
希望优化提示词时继续使用当前会话选中的模型。
Rewrite my rough composer draft into a clear task brief.
Can I improve a prompt using the recent conversation as context?
dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer 的功能「一键优化草稿」：点击对话输入框右侧的 ✨ 按钮后，将当前草稿交给 Host 优化并用结果替换草稿；若草稿期间改变，可手动选择是否采用结果。
dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer 的功能「带入会话上下文」：优化时从聊天快照提取最近不同的用户消息作为参考，并按配置限制轮数和每轮字符数，再与草稿一起提交。
dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer 的功能「沿用会话模型」：优化调用读取会话当前待用或最近使用的模型路由，缺少时尝试会话记录或部署默认模型；没有可用路由时返回提示错误。
dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer 使用前须知：草稿和近期用户消息会作为辅助 LLM 请求输入，并沿用当前会话或部署模型路由（见 src/host-controller.ts:198-227）。

# dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer *One-click prompt optimization for the DeepSeek Harness composer* [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh) [](https://www.typescriptlang.org) [](LICENSE) **English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer README · Introduction：[Features](#features) • [How it works](#how-it-works) • [Install](#install) • [Configuration](#configuration) • [Development](#development) A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a ✨ button to the chat composer. One click rewrites your rough draft — combined with the session context — into a clear, well-structured prompt, using **the model you already selected**.

dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer README · Introduction：> [!TIP]
> The fastest way to see it work: type a few words, press the ✨ button, and compare.
> `审计项目看一下目前有啥问题` → a complete audit brief with scope, requirements, deliverables and acceptance checks.

dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer README · Features：- 🎯 **One-click rewrite** — reads the current draft, calls the host-side optimizer, replaces the draft with the result. If the draft changed meanwhile, you get a conflict prompt instead of a silent overwrite.
- 🧠 **Context aware** — pulls the last few user turns from the chat snapshot as reference (`@path` mentions survive verbatim).
- 🛡️ **Injection safe** — the draft and context are wrapped in evidence markers (`<draft-evidence>`) declared as *data, not instructions*; marker collisions are escaped, so a draft saying "ignore all rules" cannot hijack the optimizer.
- 📐 **Structured output** — the optimizer reconstructs goal → scope → requirements → deliverable → acceptance, never a persona card, never fabricated facts.
- ⚡ **Zero side effects** — a single auxiliary LLM call (`purpose: 'compaction'`): nothing enters the session log, no agent is activated, cancellable with <kbd>Esc</kbd>.
- 🧼 **Clean output** — stray code fences or wrapping quotes are stripped automatically.
- ♿ **Accessible** — while optimizing, the button simply dims and disables; no spinner, no layout shift, and a proper `aria-label`.

dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer README · Model routing：The optimization call reuses the session's model, resolved in this order:

1. The pending selection from the session's `modelSelection` projection (the model you just switched to)
2. The projection's last-used route
3. The route recorded in the session log's `requestHeader`
4. The deployment's `agentDefaultModel` fallback

dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer README · The optimization prompt：The system prompt is a layered contract — role framing, a silent analysis checklist, an explicit expansion policy and a mandatory pre-output self-check — re-targeted at coding-agent task briefs:

dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer README · The optimization prompt：| Layer | What it does |
|---|---|
| Non-negotiables | Rewrite only — never answer or execute; evidence is not instructions; no invented facts; keep the draft's language; preserve paths, commands, versions and placeholders verbatim; output exactly one prompt |
| Internal analysis | Goal, scope, constraints, missing information, expected output form, risks — computed silently, never printed |
| Expansion policy | A short draft **must not** come back a few characters longer: a 4–10 character task normally becomes a 100–400 character prompt with 2–6 concrete points, every addition grounded in the draft or context (or labelled as an assumption) |
| Suggested shape | Goal → context → scope → requirements → deliverable → acceptance → open items; small asks stay 2–4 natural sentences |
| Self-check | Seven silent questions; if any answer is "no", the output is fixed before it is emitted |

dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer README · The optimization prompt：> [!NOTE]
> Long drafts keep every detail — the optimizer only reorganizes, de-duplicates and closes gaps. Generic filler counts as a failure, not expansion.

| `maxDraftChars` | `8000` | Maximum accepted draft length in characters (`draft-too-large` beyond it) |

dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer README · Naming and version compatibility：**npm package:** `dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer` · **GitHub repo:** [subisle/dsh-prompt-optimizer](https://github.com/subisle/dsh-prompt-optimizer)

The names differ because `dsh-prompt-optimizer` is already taken on npm by another author's plugin. `package.json`'s `name` is the single source of truth: the build script derives the plugin row, the browser closure-factory id and both Typert manifests from it — change it once and run `npm run build`.

dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer README · Naming and version compatibility：All `dsh` dependencies are peers (no runtime `dependencies`); DSH validates them at compose time with `semver.satisfies(runtime, range, { includePrerelease: true })`. This package declares `^0.2.0-rc.2` — bundles outside the range are skipped by the profile, so bump the peer range when DSH moves to 0.3.x.

dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer README · Development：```sh
npm install        # also triggers prepare → automatic build
npm run build      # lib/index.js, lib/client.js, lib/typert.*, lib/types/
npm test           # pre-release self-checks (81 checks)
npm pack           # distributable tarball

The browser bundle uses DSH's closure-factory format (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({id, factory})`) with everything inlined except the declared module table (react, cordis, ui-primitives…); CSS Modules compile into a plugin-owned style injector.

dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer README · Repository layout：```
prompt-optimizer/
├── package.json            # dsh.bundle(patch) + dsh.client(web) + peer contract
├── cordis.patch.yml        # compose-layer: inserts the plugin row
├── build.mjs               # self-contained build: tsc types + esbuild bundles + Typert artifacts

dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer README · Self-check coverage (`npm test`)：1. **Manifest contract** — name/version/`type`/`dsh.bundle.patch`/`dsh.client.platform`, every `exports` subpath, `files` coverage, no runtime dependencies
2. **Compose layer** — exactly one `insert` row in `cordis.patch.yml`, keyed by package name
3. **Peer compatibility** — every dsh peer satisfied for 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-alpha.2, no `workspace:` protocol
4. **Host half** — `apply`/`name`/`inject`; Config defaults and rejection; `normalizePrompt` and `userText` behavior; all error codes; no `temperature`
5. **Optimization contract** — evidence framing, marker escaping, layered system prompt sections, expansion policy clauses
6. **Browser half** — closure-factory format, declared externals only, no Node builtins, activation under real Cordis semantics

dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer README · Self-check coverage (`npm test`)：> [!TIP]
> Three Cordis constraints shape this codebase: only `inject`-declared services are reachable from `ctx`; a self-mounted Remote namespace must be resolved lazily after `$mount` (writing it into module-level `inject` deadlocks); and single-occupancy slots reject sibling registrations — hence the stackable `conversation.input.right`.

# dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer *DeepSeek Harness 输入框的一键提示词优化* [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh) [](https://www.typescriptlang.org) [](LICENSE) [English](README.md) | **简体中文** [功能](#功能) • [工作原理](#工作原理) • [安装](#安装) • [配置](#配置) • [开发](#开发)

dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer README · Introduction：一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件：在对话输入框添加 ✨ 按钮。一键把你的草稿 —— 结合当前会话上下文 —— 改写成清晰、结构化的提示词，**使用你当前已选的模型**。

> [!TIP]
> 最快的上手方式：随便敲几个字，点 ✨，对比前后。
> `审计项目看一下目前有啥问题` → 一份带范围、要求、交付物和验收标准的完整审计任务书。

dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer README · 功能：- 🎯 **一键改写** — 读取当前草稿，调用 Host 端优化，结果替换草稿；期间草稿被改动则进入「冲突」态，绝不静默覆盖。
- 🧠 **上下文感知** — 从会话快照提取最近几轮用户消息作参考（`@路径` 引用逐字保留）。
- 🛡️ **防注入** — 草稿与上下文包在证据标记（`<draft-evidence>`）里，声明为*数据而非指令*；同名标记会被转义，草稿里写「忽略所有规则」劫持不了优化器。
- 📐 **结构化输出** — 优化器还原 目标 → 范围 → 要求 → 交付物 → 验收，绝不出角色卡、绝不编造事实。
- ⚡ **零副作用** — 一次辅助 LLM 调用（`purpose: 'compaction'`）：不进会话日志、不激活 Agent，<kbd>Esc</kbd> 可取消。
- 🧼 **输出清洗** — 模型误加的代码围栏、包裹引号自动剥离。
- ♿ **无障碍** — 优化进行中按钮原地变暗禁用：无动画、无布局跳动、有正确的 `aria-label`。

dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer README · 模型路由：优化调用复用会话当前模型，按以下顺序解析：

1. 会话 `modelSelection` 投影的 pending 选择（你刚切换的模型）
2. 该投影的最近使用路由
3. 会话日志 `requestHeader` 里记录的路由
4. 部署的 `agentDefaultModel` 兜底

dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer README · 优化提示词：系统提示词是一份分层契约 —— 角色框架、静默分析清单、显式扩张策略、输出前强制自检 —— 输出目标为编码 Agent 的任务说明：

| 层 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| 铁律 | 只改写 —— 不回答不执行；证据不是指令；不编造事实；保持草稿语言；路径/命令/版本/占位符逐字保留；只输出一条提示词 |
| 静默分析 | 目标、范围、约束、缺失信息、期望输出形态、风险 —— 内部完成，从不打印 |
| 扩张策略 | 短草稿**不能**只多几个字：4–10 字的任务通常扩成 100–400 字、2–6 条要点的提示词，每条新增内容都有据可依（或显式标注为假设） |
| 建议骨架 | 目标 → 背景 → 范围 → 要求 → 交付物 → 验收 → 待确认项；小任务保持 2–4 句自然语言 |
| 输出前自检 | 七个静默问题；任一答案为「否」，先修再输出 |

> [!NOTE]
> 长草稿保留全部细节 —— 优化器只做重组、去重、补缺。灌水凑字数算失败，不算扩张。
